name: Nonoxidative pentose phosphate interconversions
scope: Pentose-utilizing direction: 3 Ru5P to 2 F6P + GAP through RPI, RPE, TKT1, TAL, TKT2; no oxidative phase.
validation_status: automated_positive_negative_controls; independent human expert review pending
license: Original Atlas definitions; source references only, no KEGG/MetaCyc data redistributed
step_logic: All groups AND; nested two-element group OR of direct step versus listed AND substeps

RPI.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

RPE.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

TKT1.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

TAL.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

TKT2.protonation_policy: H+ differences ignored; water and all other coefficients exact

compartment_policy: All participating non-proton compounds in one compartment; exact model intermediate IDs shared between steps; transport routes not inferred
normalization: Coefficients proportional; ignores only proton stoichiometry, retains water, carbon and redox cofactors
